page.content:
Imperial island nation that launched the Hundred Year War.

How Fire Nation connects

  • Character: Zuko — Zuko is a prince of the Fire Nation.
  • Character: Ozai — Ozai is Fire Lord during Aang's war.
  • Character: Iroh — Iroh is a Fire Nation general and uncle to the throne.
  • Character: Azula — Azula is a princess of the Fire Nation.
  • Character: Sozin — Sozin was the Fire Lord who began the war.
  • Character: Avatar Roku — Roku was born in the Fire Nation before becoming Avatar.

What is Fire Nation?

The Fire Nation is the industrial empire of Sozin, Azulon, and Ozai — Zuko and Azula's home — whose comet-boosted firebending nearly ends the other nations.

Key threads lead to Zuko, Ozai, Iroh, Azula, Sozin and Avatar Roku.
